question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a black ball, Dave has a yellow ball, Eve has a purple ball, Fred has a orange ball, and Gertrude has a white ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Finally, Fred and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) brown ball
(C) black ball
(D) yellow ball
(E) purple ball
(F) orange ball
(G) white ball
solution:
Ball colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: teal, brown, black, yellow, purple, orange, white.
1. Alice ↔ Fred: orange, brown, black, yellow, purple, teal, white.
2. Bob ↔ Gertrude: orange, white, black, yellow, purple, teal, brown.
3. Claire ↔ Eve: orange, white, purple, yellow, black, teal, brown.
4. Claire ↔ Gertrude: orange, white, brown, yellow, black, teal, purple.
5. Dave ↔ Gertrude: orange, white, brown, purple, black, teal, yellow.
6. Eve ↔ Fred: orange, white, brown, purple, teal, black, yellow.
7. Fred ↔ Dave: orange, white, brown, black, teal, purple, yellow.
Claire has the brown ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
